SAFETY FLAG: PMV65XP per Nexperia datasheet has Vds_max = -20V only (NOT -50V as the generate.py comment incorrectly states). During a D1 SMBJ24A TVS clamp event the rail spikes to 38.9V — Q1 Vds_max would be EXCEEDED by ~19V. For continuous 24V operation Q1 sees ~0V Vds (it's conducting). The risk is only during a surge event. For production reliability strongly consider substituting AO3401A (C15127 Vds=-30V) or for full margin DMP4015SK3 (C513222 Vds=-40V but TO-252 package — would require footprint change).
